subject: HILLS
name: Hills — winding light through cool woodland

styleSelection.reason: Loose woodland landscape: connected transparent local-color washes, a dry connected shadow glaze, and sparse sepia structure around the path bend.

families.referenceCue: Warm yellow-green upper slopes taper between cool crowns; broad transparent field wash, no individual grass blades or outlined hill bands.
Pale winding upper path is a lightly ochre-painted plane; preserve near-paper center and let the woodland define interrupted edges.

Cool blue-grey and olive woodland forms connected irregular crowns. Start with transparent cool wash, dry completely, glaze coherent shadow groups across crown and trunk boundaries; no stipple or leaf discs.
The luminous lower meadow wraps around the path: connected hansa/ochre/sap-green wash; preserve pale breaks and shade ground turns with the shared dry shadow support. Grass remains a value plane.
Foreground path bends beside the main spreading tree and narrows up the slope. Warm cream light plane, small existing near-paper flecks, no full ink perimeter.

Foreground woodland at left and right frames the path. Broad mixed cool-dark mass, dry, then selective connected shadow glaze crossing crowns and trunks; fine branching structure carried by sparse sepia lines on measured dry paper.
